instruction: Detect and analyze trends in time-series data using statistical and mathematical approaches. Implement linear and polynomial regression to fit trend lines, apply the Mann-Kendall test to assess monotonic trend significance, and compute Sen's slope estimator for robust trend magnitude estimation. Handle non-stationary data by differencing or detrending before further analysis. Visualize the original signal alongside the fitted trend and report trend direction, slope, and statistical significance (p-value).
description: Analyze and detect trends in time-series data using linear regression, polynomial fitting, and the Mann-Kendall statistical test with Sen's slope estimation.
keywords: trend analysis, Mann-Kendall test, linear trend, polynomial trend, Sen's slope, detrending, time-series, python, scipy, statsmodels, monotonic trend
